tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa skya dkor dpon par nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge 'gro don bzang po bzhugs so// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje'i spyan ras drag pos 'gro kun la/ /gzigs pa mi g.yel gangs can lha gcig dang / /dbyer med sa skya pa la gus btud nas/ /'gro la dge bskul rim pa bstan par bya/ /de la 'dir thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs 'di nyid ni sngon byung bskal pa 'dzin pa zhes bya ba la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa dpal brtsegs rgyal po zhes bya bar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ slar yang bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su 'od dpag med dam mgon po tshe dpag med kyi bstan pa la sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan nas 'gro ba spyi dang bye brag mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams kyi ya gyal bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'di bdag cag gi ston pas sku dngos kyi gdul byar ma gyur pa la brten nas spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul byar gsungs pa bzhin/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'di nyid rnam sprul du mas mi'i 'gro ba spel zhing / rgyal blon mkhas grub du ma'i rnam par rol par bstan te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa btsugs nas 'gro rnams yang dag pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa yin la/ de thams cad kyi nang nas kyang ches mchog tu gyur pa ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi snying po/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes yi ge drug pa lha mchog gang gi snying por gyur pa 'di nyid ni/ byin rlabs nus mthu phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo dang / rgyal po bka' thang / padma bka' thang sogs nas gsungs pa ltar yin zhing / de nyid snga mo nas bzung ma'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi ngag la rlung ltar grags pa las/ rang nyid chos rje khu dbon gyi sku thog tsam la sprul pa'i skyes chen mnga' bdag myang nyi ma 'od zer gyis bka' dang bstan chos du ma'i khungs la brten nas/

ma ṇi khri bskor dang lag bskor btsugs/ dbyangs snyan pos khrom gyi gseb tu chos spyod mgur ma rnam thar sogs dang spel nas bskul bar mdzad pa'i rgyun byung ba 'di la dbyangs thams cad kyi khungs dang po yin/ phyis su rang re'i bla ma sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku thog tsam la mdog sman sding pa lo chen ratna bha drwas ma ṇi'i gdangs chen bco brgyad mdzad pa sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi bu chen rnams la gdangs dbyangs du ma yod pa bzhin dge bskul phyogs tha dad du 'byon srol byung ba'i nang tshan/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid nas kyang bu chen byung 'dug pa'i thog ma de/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i sku thog tsam la e yin snyam yang lo rgyus nges gsal ma mthong / de nas ma 'gyangs par bdag chen gzhi thog pa kun dga' rin chen dang / kun dga' dbang phyug sogs kyi sku dus la rje btsun mar pa'i slob ma mes ston chen mo'i brgyud pa sa skya dang nye skor ga ra dpa' lung du 'phel ba'i brgyud pa las sgo rum sku gnyer rim can dang / bskor dpon bsko bzhag mdzad de/ sa skya bskor chen pa sum stong la nye ba tsam khrid nas chos 'khor lha sa'i jo shāka mjal ba sogs gnas dang rten du ma mjal gsol byung skabs/ dbus 'gros pa rnams gtsang chen sgrol bar khag sbyong chen po byung bas/ grub chen thang stong rgyal pos thugs kyis ma bzod par dpal chu bo ri'i lcags zam ngo mtshar can 'di nyid 'dzugs par mdzad/ de nas dus dbang 'ga' zhig gis bskor chen gyi rgyun de nyid/ bu chen 'gro srol phyi mo'i bar ma byung tshod 'dug kyang bar skabs su nyams pa'i tshe/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i sku thog la dge sdings ma ṇi ba mngags/ de dag kyang dus phyis khyim 'dzin par song bas bskor dpon du 'os pa zhig ma byung ba na/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyi sku thog la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po lha khang chen mo nas 'os su gyur pa re bsko bzhag mdzad pa'i rgyun bzhin deng sang gi bar du 'dug pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir/

rang lugs dang rjes 'brel ma ṇi bskul ba'i rnam gzhag mdor bsdus tsam 'dri na/ bskor dpon su yin des las 'bras khyad du ma bsad par rang nyid chos tshul bzang po la gnas thog nas gzhan phan byed pa'i tshe/ 'brel thogs kyis thog drangs sems can thams cad yi ge drug pa'i sgo nas 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod kyi sems bskyed dang ma bral bar byas la/ thang ga byin can/ mchod rdzas phran bu rnams gtsang zhing bkod pa mdzes par bshams drung / rang nyid bod kyi rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs lhun chags shing spyod lam bag dang ldan pa la/ sa zhu lding gon/ ma bskor dang phreng ba mdzes par thogs te/ bskor ba'i sna'am khrom chen po'i gseb tu ma dbyangs snyan par bskul la 'di skad do/ /bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' yi/ /mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa/ /dus 'di nas ni byang chub ma thob bar/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rnams/ /gcig tu bsdus pa sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun gyi mnga' bdag che/ /zhes pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /sgo gsum༞ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin ston pa sangs rgyas la/ /sgo gsum༞ /lung rtogs bdag nyid bstan pa'i dam chos la/ /sgo gsum༞ /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /sgo gsum༞ /zhes pa'i ci nus brjod pa'i mthar/ bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rin po che/ /rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /khyed kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag yid gsum byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ /bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin༞ /dam chos lam du longs par༞ /lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar༞ /'khrul snang dbyings su 'char bar༞ /chos min rnam rtog 'gag par༞ /byams dang snying rje skye bar༞ /byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs par༞

/myur du rnam mkhyen thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab la/ ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /don du bla med byang chub thob par bya/ /de yi ched du sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ /zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs bgyis te/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /las nyon sdig sgrib nad gdon zhi ba'i phyir/ /gsung mchog yi ge drug pa'i dbyangs snyan gyis/ /snang ba dam pa'i chos la bsgyur bar bya/ /rnam dag chos kyis dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la phyogs bcur gzigs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las stsol mdzad pa'i/ /dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs dus kun na skyabs su bka' bstod cing / /nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas/ /dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol/ /bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa la/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo rgyud man ngag rig gnas bcas/ /thub bstan ji bzhin gsal mdzad pa'i/ /'dzam gling mkhas grub thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs mun pa'i smag rum du/ /rgyal bstan nyi 'od gsal mdzad pa'i/ /gangs ljongs bstan 'dzin thams cad la/ /rtse gcig dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgyal srid la/ /dbang bsgyur rje btsun sa skya pa/ /yab sras bu slob mkhas grub la/

/bka' drin rjes dran phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brgyud pa'i bla ma spyi bye brag dang / de gras chos rje'i gsung rab nas 'byung ba ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling du bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs/ /kha ba can 'dir chos kyi sgron me sbar/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras kyi gtso/ /mkhan chen zhi ba tsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul bya sna tshogs 'dul ba'i phyir/ /khro chags sgeg dang zhi ba'i sku/ /grub gnyis stsol mdzad rgyud sde bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge zhing / /rnam par dkar la ma 'dres pa/ /nges par 'byung ba mchog gi lam/ /dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa/ /lha dang mi yis mchod pa'i gnas/ /rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom pa/ /tshogs mchog dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan zhing / /ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gnas/ /bde gshegs bstan pa legs 'dzin pa'i/ /bshes gnyen kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis/ /lus btud pa yis rnam kun du/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang / /snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgra/ /bla ma'i tshogs dang dkon mchog mchod/ /'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas par/ /bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i/ /mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa/ /blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi/ /rab dang yid las byung gyur pa'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ni/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa du ma yis/ /yon tan rgyal mtsho sras bcas mchod/ /sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pas 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/

/'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyo dang / /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gus pas khyed la dbul bar bgyi/ /kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa/ /yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /bdag gi 'di dag bzhes pa dang / /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por bsngo/ /oṃ swa bha wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bha wa shuddho3 haṃ/ chos dbyings mtha' bral chen po'i ngang nyid las/ /dgos 'dod sna tshogs stsol ba'i rin chen khri/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos padma'i gdan/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku dngos spyan ras gzigs/ /dri med dung dang chu shel lta bu'i mdog /shin tu yid 'ong 'dzum zhal zhi zhing sgeg /phyag bzhi'i dang po thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /'og ma shel phreng nor bu padma 'dzin/ /rab mdzes zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /yid 'phrog dar dang rin chen du mas spras/ /mthon mthing ral pa'i thor gtsug lcang los mdzes/ /gang de'i spyi bor sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes gcig bsdus skyabs gnas kun gyi gtso/ /ngo bo bla ma rnam pa 'od dpag med/ /rigs bdag tshul du dges zhing bzhugs par gyur/ /rang nyid lha sku me long gzugs bzhin snang / /snang stong zung du 'jug pa sgyu ma'i gar/ /gar mkhan bzang ltar cha lugs du mas mdzes/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong yid kyi snang brnyan no/ /zhes lha la yid cung zad bzung nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma la mos pa rtse gcig tu byas te/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/

/yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis dgongs su gsol/ /las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs par༞ /yang dag ting 'dzin skye par༞ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin༞ /zhes snying thag pa nas gsol ba lan gsum la sogs pa btab la/ 'khor 'das bde sdug kun la khyab pa'i chos/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba rang gi sems/ /sems nyid brtags na kha dog dbyings su med/ /med phyir gcig dang du ma'i ngo bos stong / /stong pa'i dbang gis skye 'gag gnas gsum bral/ /bral yang gsal snang ma 'gag spros kun zhi/ /zhi ba'i sems nyid mtha' bral chen po'o/ /zhes yid byed thams cad bral ba'i ngang la lhod de bzhag snying dbus pad zla'i steng du hrīḥyig mthar/ /yig drug sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje bskul nas bdag byin brlabs/ /'gro drug sems can rnams kyi don mdzad gyur/ /par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ de nas rnam thar sogs 'gro bskul chog pas 'dir dpal sa skya'i gdung rabs byon tshul mdor bsdus bskul ba'i dbang du btang nas/ zab rgyas chos kun gzigs pa'i snang ba yis/ /ngo mtshar shes bya'i gnas kun gsal mdzad cing / /bsam yas sprul pa'i 'od gzugs 'gyed mkhas pa'i/ /'jam mgon skye dgu'i nyi ma la btud nas/ /'jam gling byang phyogs nyin mor byed pa'i mgon/ /lha babs 'khon gyi pā la chen po las/ /sprul pa'i gdung rgyud rim par byon pa'i tshul/ /ya rabs rnams kyi kha rgyan 'di spel lo/ /'jam dbyangs sprul pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /gdung gi thog ma 'od gsal lha yul du/ /spyi ring g.yu ring g.yu se mched gsum byon/ /g.yu ses mi rje mdzad nas sras bzhi bskrun/ /de yi grogs su gcen po g.yu ring byon/ /g.yu ring dang ni mu bza' ldem bu'i sras/ /ma sangs spun bdun byon pa'i gcen po drug

/yab dang bcas pa lha yi yul du gshegs/ /bdun gyi tha chung ma sangs spyi rje dang / /thog lcam 'ur mo'i sras ni dpa' bo stag /de dang klu lcam bra ma gnyis kyi sras/ /klu tshang stag po 'od can zhes pa byung / /klu tsha dang ni mon bza' mtsho mo rgyal/ /lhan cig bzhugs pa'i rigs sras g.ya' spang gi /mtshams su 'khrungs pas mtshan yang g.ya' spang skyes/ /zhes grags gzhan gyis mi thub dpa' bo byon/ /gang des srin po skya rings khrag med ni/ /bsad nas chung ma g.ya' 'brum si li ma/ /phrogs te nyid kyis khab su bzhes pa las/ /sras gcig byung ba 'khon bar skyes zhes grags/ /de dang btsan bza' lcam bu sgron gyi sras/ /gzugs mdzes blo ldan mi yul dkon pa 'khrungs/ /de la dkon pa rje gung stag ces btags/ /'khon ston dpal po cher grags snyan rtser byon/ /dpal po cher grags glang bza' ne chung sras/ /khri mdzes lha legs tshe la dbang phyug dang / /mkhas mchog klu yi dbang po tshe 'dzin bzhi/ /tshe 'dzin sras ni rdo rje rin po che/ /gang de'i btsun mo 'bro bza' g.yang len skyid/ /de la 'bro tsha mched bdun byon pa las/ /gzhan rnams yul phyogs so sor 'gro don mdzad/ /mtha' ltag shes rab yon tan grom par byon/ /de nas yon tan 'byung gnas tshul khrims rgyal/ /gtsug tor shes rab dge skyabs dge mthong dang / /'khon ston bal po shākya blo gros rnams/ /rim bzhin snga ma'i rigs sras phyi ma yin/ /shākya blo gros sras gnyis che ba'i mtshan/ /shes rab tshul khrims dkon mchog rgyal po gcung / /gcen po yan chad gsang sngags snga 'gyur mdzad/ /gcung gis gsar 'gyur srol bskyangs sa skya btab/ /de dang zhang mo bsod nams skyid kyi sras/ /sa skya'i bla chen kun dga' snying por grags/ /bla chen de yi btsun mo tsha rong ma/ /jo lcam phur mo'i sras ni kun dga' 'bar/ /btsun mo gnyis pa jo lcam 'od sgron sras/

/bsod nams rtse mo rje btsun grags pa dang / /dpal chen 'od po zhes bya rnam gsum yin/ /dpal chen 'od po'i btsun mo'i gar phu ma/ /nyi khri lcam la sa skya paṇa chen dang / /zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis 'khrungs/ /zangs tsha'i btsun mo mdog stod tshwa sna ma/ /ma gcig kun skyid sras po 'phags pa dang / /'gro mgon phyag na rdo rje mched gnyis byon/ /btsun mo gnyis pa sa skya'i chu mdo ma/ /jo 'gro'i sras po slob dpon rin rgyal te/ /gsum pa ma gcig rdo rje gdan gyi sras/ /slob dpon chen po ye shes 'byung gnas so/ /phyag na'i btsun mo ma gcig zhwa lu ma/ /mkha' 'gro 'bum sras dharma pā la yin/ /dharma pā la'i btsun mo stag 'bum sras/ /ratna bha drwa gzhon nu'i dus su gshegs/ /ye 'byung btsun mo ma gcig kha smad ma/ /chos rin skyid la bdag nyid chen po 'khrungs/ /gang de'i btsun mo dang po rgyal po'i lcam/ /mu dag gan gyi sras ni bsod nams bzang / /de dang dpon mo buddha gan gyi sras/ /ratna shrī yang gzhon nu'i dus su gshegs/ /btsun mo gnyis pa mang mkhar sogs spel ma/ /ngang mo'i sras ni ti shrī kun blo yin/ /btsun mo gsum pa glang tsho'i na spel ma/ /nam mkha' rgyal por grags la sras gsum ste/ /mkhas btsun chen po nam mkha' legs pa dang / /nam mkha' bshes gnyen gu shrī nam rgyal lo/ /mkhas btsun chen po'i btsun mo khang gsar la/ /dge 'dun 'bum la ta dben kun rin 'khrungs/ /kun rin btsun mo nyi thog nam pa'i sras/ /blon po chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan yin/ /gnyis pa mnyam med dbon mo dge ma'i sras/ /slob dpon chen po grags pa blo gros dang / /gcung po kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan no/ /blo gros rgyal mtshan btsun mo sa skya ma/ /rgyal mo skyid sras kun dga' dbang phyug ste/ /grags pa blo gros btsun mo brag dkar ma'i/ /sras mchog blo gros dbang phyug gzhi thog pa'o/

༈ /bdag nyid chen po'i btsun mo zhwa lu ma/ /ma gcig gzhon 'bum mtshan gzhan lug skyes la/ /ta dben kun nyi 'jam dbyangs don yod pa/ /'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan mched gsum 'khrungs/ /'jam dbyangs don yod btsun mo zhwa lu ma/ /ma gcig yon tan dpal 'bum zhes bya'i sras/ /nyi ma rgyal mtshan bla chen kun rgyal gnyis/ /bla chen kun rgyal btsun mo zhwa lu ma/ /ma gcig nam mkha' rgyal mo zhes bya la/ /'jam dbyangs chen po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang / /mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ /'jam dbyangs nam rgyal btsun mo khro 'da' ma/ /ma gcig dpal 'byung rgyal mo zhes bya'i sras/ /rgya gar shes rgyal blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug btsun mo 'dan yul ma/ /kun dga' 'bum sras grags pa rgyal mtshan te/ /de rnams rin chen sgang pa'i zhal ngo'o/ ༈ /bdag nyid chen po'i btsun mo ra lung ma/ /kun dga' nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya'i sras/ /ti shrī kun dga' legs 'byung zhes bya dang / /gcung pa ti shrī kun dga' rgyal mtshan gnyis/ /kun rgyal btsun mo stag sde kha phyar ma/ /dpal ldan bzang mo'i sras ni chos rgyal mtshan/ /btsun mo gnyis pa stag sde ra lung ma/ /bsod nams dpal la ta dben blo rgyal 'khrungs/ /ta dben chos rgyal btsun mo chu mdo ma/ /rgyal mo mtsho sras theg chen chos rje yin/ /btsun mo gnyis pa nyang stod sa skya la/ /dharma dhwa dza rdo rje rin chen gnyis/ /btsun mo gsum pa dpon mo sras pa la/ /slob dpon chen po bsod nams bkra shis 'khrungs/ /bsod bkras btsun mo stag sde ra lung ma/ /nam pa'i sras po bde legs bkra shis yin/ /bde legs bkra shis btsun mo gcig bzhes pa/ /gang de'i sras po bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /shākya seng ge don grub rgyal mtshan dang / /bsam grub rgyal mtshan zhes bya rnam bzhi'o/ /shāka seng btsun mo gcung pa dpon mo'i sras/

/kun dga' bkra shis kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / /kun dga' snying po zhes bya rnam pa gsum/ /btsun mo gnyis pa ma gcig yum pa'i sras/ /chos rje rin chen rgyal mtshan zhes bya dang / /kun rgyal btsun mo gling kha'i dpon chen sras/ /dkar mo'i mtshan la chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / /gcung po kun dga' legs 'byung rnam gnyis 'khrungs/ /de rnams lha khang bla brang gdung brgyud do/ ༈ /bdag nyid chen po'i btsun mo re mda' ma/ /lha gcig nyi ma rin chen zhes bya'i sras/ /gcen po slob dpon chen po nyi ma dpal/ /chung ba kun dga' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dbang / /kun legs btsun mo ma gcig kha gsar ma/ /dge 'dun 'bum sras bla chen bsod blo dang / /dbang gi mtshan gsol grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis/ /grags rgyal btsun mo ma gcig lha rin la/ /slob dpon chen po kun dga' legs blo dang / /rnam sras rgyal mtshan dbang zhes grags pa 'khrungs/ /btsun mo gnyis pa stag tshang sras 'dren sras/ /slob dpon chen po 'jam dbyangs chos rgyal yin/ /rnam sras btsun mo rta nag 'brug dgu'i sras/ /slob dpon chen po kun dga' blo gros te/ /btsun mo gnyis pa cha gcig ya 'brog ma/ /bsod nams 'bum la nam mkha' legs pa 'khrungs/ /nam legs btsun mo ma gcig btsun ma skyid/ /ces bya'i sras ni nam mkha' rgyal mtshan yin/ /nam rgyal btsun mo shangs pa rgyal mo'i sras/ /slob dpon chen po nam mkha' rin chen no/ /btsun mo gnyis pa dpal 'byor bzang mo'i sras/ /dbang gi mtshan gsol nam mkha' bkra shis yin/ /nam mkha' bkra shis btsun mo dma' po bza'/ /ma gcig hor mo tshe brtan zhes bya'i sras/ /'jam dbyangs sprul sku kun dga' bsod nams dang / /ngag gi dbang phyug dang ni 'jam dpal grags/ /sangs rgyas tshe brtan bkra shis zhes bya bzhi/ /tshe brtan btsun mo ya 'brog khri lcam sras/ /kun dga' bsam grub ngag dbang kun rin gnyis/ /kun dga' bsam grub btsun mo ma gcig sras/

/kun dga' bde legs bkra shis zhes bya 'khrungs/ /kun dga' bde legs btsun mo bya bzang ma'i/ /sras la 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub dang / /tshe dbang hor sogs bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /'jig rten rgya hor zhes bya rnam gsum byon/ /'jig rten rgya hor btsun mo stag lung mar/ /sras gsum byon pa'i gcen po gzhon nur gshegs/ /bar pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /chung ba ngag dbang lhun grub rnam gnyis byon/ /ngag dbang lhun grub btsun mo bol gdong ma/ /nor bu bu khrid sras ni bstan 'dzin dbang / /bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po rnam gnyis byon/ /dbang rgyal sras gnyis tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang / /ngag dbang nor bu rgyal mtshan zhes bya ste/ /phyis su byon pa'i rtse gdong bla brang pa/ /ngag dbang kun rin btsun mo gdong kha ma/ /lha gcig dkar mo legs 'dzam zhes bya'i sras/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po dang / /btsun mo gnyis pa slar yang gdong kha ma/ /bkra shis dpal gyi bu khrid ces bya'i sras/ /'dzam gling rgyan mchog grags pa'i mtshan can 'khrungs/ /gang de'i btsun mo byang phyogs rgyal po'i lcam/ /lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo zhes bya'i sras/ /'jam dbyangs sprul pa mthu stobs dbang phyug dang / /rgyal sras ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal mtshan/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam mgon a mes zhabs/ /mkhyen yang kun dga'i mtshan can bstan 'gro'i dpal/ /dpal ldan de yi btsun mo 'gro mgon ma/ /o rgyan skyabs la bsod nams dbang phyug bltams/ /gang de'i btsun mo ma gcig zhed chos ma/ /pad dkar bu khrid sras ni madga'i mtshan/ /de yi btsun mo sngon ma gnas gdong ma/ /gdung brgyud ma byon phyi ma bco brgyad pa'i/ /ma gcig bstan 'dzin bsod nams bzang mo la/ /kho bo'i skyabs gcig khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen zhes/ /snyigs dus mgon de skye ba'i cho 'phrul bstan/

/mgon de'i btsun mo snga ma zhe chos pa'i/ /lha mdzes bu khrid sras gnyis chung ngur gshegs/ /phyi ma sku drin can gyi 'gro mgon ma/ /ma gcig bsod nams dpal gyi dbang mo la/ /ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros 'di nyid dang / /gcung po zung bcas byon pa'i gcung gnyis gshegs/ /gcen las da lta'i gdung brgyud 'di nyid sogs/ /da ltar byon dang ma 'ongs srid mtha'i bar/ /'byon par nges pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /gdung rabs rim par byon pa 'di nyid la/ /de ltar 'chi med 'od gsal lha yi rigs/ /ma rig las 'khon 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku/ /sa skya pa zhes grags pa gsal ldan pa/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i rnam thar bsdus pa 'di/ /gzhan gyis bskul dang rang nyid mos pa'i blos/ /legs par bkod 'dis mtha' yas skye dgu rnams/ /mchod 'os mchod sogs ya rabs spyod tshul gyis/ /mtho ris thar pa'i bde la reg gyur cig /ces pa sogs ma ṇi ji ltar rigs pa bskul/ gzhan gyi ja 'dren na ja mchod/ thugs pa sogs gzhan ster mi byung na/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs/ shi gson gyi bsngo 'brel 'bum ba rnams la dmigs grol khar bsngo ba bya tshul ni/ ma ṇi bskul bgrang dang / gnas mal zas nor sogs mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i dge ba 'dis mtshon rang gzhan thams cad kyis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad mthar thug sangs rgyas dang / gnas skabs dag pa'i zhing dang / mtho ris su skye bar gyur cig snyam pa'i mos pa dang / don la 'khor 'das thams cad gsal stong 'dzin med du shes pa'i ngang nas/ bla ma dam pa brgyud par bcas rnams dang / /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad dang / /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems sogs/ /thams cad bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /de'i rjes su thog mar mthar thug gi bsngo ba bgyi ba ni/ shi gson rnams kyi 'brel bzhag tshul dang / ming byang rnams bklag la/

'di zhes bya ba rnams byung bas/ zhes sbyar nas/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med dam chos ldan/ /phyi ma bde ba can gyi zhing skyes nas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang go 'phang myur thob shog /lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi/ /khyer so gsum dang nam yang mi 'bral bar/ /snying rje'i dbang gis sems can don spyod cing / /rgyal ba'i sras kyis spyod pa sgrub par shog /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /'dren mchog bla ma 'od dpag med mgon gyis/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus nam yang mi gtang bar/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa kun las skyob gyur cig /gnas skabs kyi bsngo ba ni/ 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /yul dus gnas skabs kun tu mi nyams par/ /phyogs mthar dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i skyob pa mchog gyur pa/ /mkhas grub rgyal mtshos yongs su gang ba'i gnas/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bstan pa gsal mdzad pa'i/ /sa skya pa yi bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /bla ma sku khams bzang bar gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog tu sku tshe ring bar༞ /'phrin las dar zhing rgyas par༞/bla ma dang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /gangs can bod kyi lte ba rdo rje'i gdan/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid rgyas byed pa'i/ /sprul pa'i gdung brgyud rgyun chad med pa dang / /kun kyang 'phrin las nam mkha' mnyam par shog /dge 'dun sde rnams 'chad nyan 'phel ba dang / /bstan pa ris med dar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sgrub pa po rnams g.yeng bas ma gos pas/ /ting 'dzin las su rung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/ /bstan 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma la/

/gsol 'debs sdig pa ma lus bshags/ /don kun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag la dmigs rten grangs med pa/ /byung ba'i tshe 'das thams cad kyi/ /sdig pa kun bshags kun byang nas/ /kun kyang bde ba can bgrod shog /bdag gis dus gsum sems can gyi/ srog gcod sdig pa ci bgyis bshags/ /de dag bde ba can skye zhing / /bdag sogs 'gro kun der 'gro shog /bdag gis bstan 'gro'i don bsgrub phyir/ /dus gsum sdig pa thams cad bshags/ /dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /lhan cig bde chen bgrod par shog /bdag gi lhag bsam nus mthu dang / /mkhyen brtse nus ldan skyabs gnas kun/ /gcig bsdus bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /'di phyi'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub ji snyed dang / /mchog gsum rten gsum bgrang yas sogs/ /bsod nams zhing gyur ci mchis la/ /bdag gzhan zhing rdul lus bsgyur nas/ /phyag mchod sdig bshags bskor ba bskul/ /sgrib sbyangs dag pa'i zhing bgrod nas/ /sprul pas bstan pa rgyas byed shog /bdag gzhan dus gsum sdig kun bshags/ /kun byang rnam smin 'byung med shog /dge tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /tshogs rdzogs 'di phyi'i don 'grub shog /sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /tshe 'dir bsam pa'i don 'grub cing / /bar chad zhi nas bkra shis pa/ /bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog /sbyin pa'i bdag po chos dang mthun pa yi/ /ji ltar bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa'i tshogs/ /nye bar zhi bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /sems can nad pa ji snyed pa/ /myur du nad las thar bar shog /'gro ba'i nad rnams ma lus pa/ /rtag tu 'byung ba med par shog /dus min 'chi bar gyur pa sna tshogs dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang / /'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba rnams/

/myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol/ /chos mthun 'byor pas tshe ring gnas pa dang / /byang chub sems mchog rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs/ /rtse gcig zab mo'i ting 'dzin sgom pa la/ /bar chad med cing mthun rkyen rgyas par shog /gtsug gi nor bu bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /rdo rje'i chos skyong nus mthu dpag yas pas/ /bsam pa ji bzhin rtag tu 'grub gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu spong ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa' gang na su bzhugs pa/ /de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig /sems can 'di dag thams cad kyang / /tshe yang dpag med ring bar shog /rtag tu bde bas 'tsho gyur nas/ /'chi ba'i sgra yang grags ma gyur/ /dge ba 'di༞ /bsod nams ye shes༞ /bsod nams ye shes las༞ /dam pa gnyis༞ /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i sgra rnams pham byas nas/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'dren par shog /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bsngo ba smon lam btab tshad 'grub par shog /'gro ba'i bla ma chos rje paṇḍi ta/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog/ //sogs bkra shis byas la khrom rnams badzra gu ru dang / rigs gsum mgon po'i gzung sogs bzla bzhin par gyes su bcug yang skabs 'ga' rer gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten/ dge 'dun gyis sde dang nye bar bskul ba lta bu byung na/ 'tshogs 'phral gyes ran khar khrom rnams de phyogs la kha bltas nas phyag 'tshal du bcug la/ phyag 'tshal gyi tshigs bcad ci rigs dang /

bsnyung gnas kyi po bstod/ gtso bo rgyal ba sogs/ ltung bshags sogs bshags pa'i rigs ci shes bskul/ bsnyen gnas bsnyung gnas dang / gru lcags zam pa/ lam 'phrang mchod rten sogs gsar bzhengs zhig gso'i 'go pa bcol ba sogs byung na de dag la phan gang thogs/ nag can bskyab pa/ sems can gyi srog bslu ba sogs mdor na dge ba'i las sogs gang thon/ sems can la phan gang thogs byed pa ni dge bskul ba rnams kyi las kyi gtso bo yin no/ /de la spyir ma ṇi bskul ba 'di phal cher bstan pa'i sgor ma zhugs pa'i skye bo tha mal pa'i khrod du byed pa mang bas/ spyan 'dren phyag mchod gsol 'debs kyi rigs rnams kyang / theg pa thun mong ba dang phyogs mtshungs las/ nang dang gsang ba'i don la sbyar ba phal cher bskul mi nyan/ gtso bo la dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi rnam gzhag rnams la rang gi shes na mdo dang bstan chos kyi lung dang sbyar ba'i rgyas bshad ji tsam dgos kyang bshad chog bdag cag gi ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs dang / nyan thos byang sems dang 'brel ba'i mdzad pa rnams kyi thang kha yod na brda sprod dang bcas te bskul 'thus/ gzhan yang mdo dang 'dul ba nas bshad pa'i gtam rgyud rnams la zhing bkod dang / bskul srol byung na snyan cing ngo mtshar byin rlabs dus la 'byung yang / phal cher la mi 'dug 'grub na shin tu legs/ rgya bod mkhas grub rnams kyi rnam thar kyang spyir btang gi mdzad pa gang yin bskul rung zhing / nang dang gsang ba'i rigs bskul mi nyan/ gzugs kyi nyi ma sogs lugs kyi bstan bcos rnams bskul ba la/ phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka med/ 'on kyang bskul mkhan gyi 'du shes de la brten nas gzhan chos la bskul ba'i blo yod na phan yon 'byung / 'das log gi rnam thar thams cad ni/ sdig spang / dge sgrub kyi lo rgyus kho na yin pas shes tshad bskul/

'on kyang 'ga' re na sdig spang dge sgrub byed tshul/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mi mthun pa yang yod shas che bas/ rnam gzhag de rnams nges par byas nas gong du kho bos bsgrigs pa de sa lugs dang rjes 'brel dper brjod mdor bsdus yin pas/ des mtshon yar mtha' skyabs 'gro nas/ mar mtha' bkra shis kyi bar/ tshig bcad lhug rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang bskul kyang chog pas de bzhin shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 14 kun dga' blo gros/ sa skya dkor dpon par nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge 'gro don bzang po/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
